title: File:Secretary of Energy Visits Israel (26178756082).jpg
author: Matty Stern / U.S. Embassy Tel Aviv
description: Secretary of Energy, Dr. Ernest Moniz, visited Israel April 3-5 for a round of meetings and events with Israeli government and private sector leaders. After meeting with Prime Minister Netanyahu, Secretary Moniz also met his counterpart, Minister of Infrastructure, Energy, and Water Resources, Dr. Yuval Steinitz, with whom he signed an amendment to the U.S.-Israel Energy agreement.
